entity: West Virginia water systems' unresolved serious defects vs other states
what_we_add: the defect-case measure: pre-2022 inspection defects still open in 19% of WV cases vs 3% elsewhere, plus Louisiana 8.8% and EPA Region 9 tribal 11.3%
why: The Gazette-Mail names WV and states the same finding in words: worst-in-nation rates of unresolved serious water-system violations, 50.7% priority systems. Its measures differ from our defect-case percentages, and our 19%-vs-3% and Region 9 numbers appear nowhere.
